1. Mr. Anant Dhaka, learned counsel holding brief
of Mr. Abhilash Nainwal, learned counsel for the
appellant.
2. Counsel for the appellant states that he is not
receiving instructions from his client. I t appears that
the appellant is not interested in pursuing the present
Appeal.
3. We had issued notice in this Appeal only to
explore the possibility of a mediated settlement. I t
appears that the appellant is not interested in
mediation.
4. The Appeal is, accordingly, dismissed.
5. Pending application(s), if any, also stand
disposed of accordingly.
